auth.label: API Key
auth.description: ImageTranslate.AI API key used for translation requests. Create or copy it from your ImageTranslate.AI account at https://imagetranslate.ai.

actions.name: translate_image
actions.description: Translate text in a public image with ImageTranslate.AI, preserve the selected layout style, and return a rendered PNG up to 50 MB through transit storage. ImageTranslate.AI may charge before Connector can reject an oversized rendered result.

imageUrl.description: A public HTTP or HTTPS URL for a JPG, PNG, or WebP image no larger than 20 MB.

sourceLanguage.description: The source language as an ISO 639-1 or BCP-47 code, or auto for detection. Defaults to auto.

targetLanguage.description: The target language as an ISO 639-1 or BCP-47 code, such as en, ja, ko, zh-cn, or zh-tw.

mode.description: The layout mode: manga preserves comic text layout and strokes; general uses standard rendering; e-commerce preserves layout without strokes; light-novel overlays translated text. Defaults to general.

translator.description: The AI translation model. Defaults to grok.

customPrompt.description: Additional translation instructions, terminology, character context, or style guidance.

idempotencyKey.description: A caller-generated UUID that must be reused when retrying the same translation after a timeout to avoid duplicate credit charges.

inputSchema.description: Input for translating text in an image while preserving its visual layout.

recordId.description: The ImageTranslate.AI record ID to include when contacting provider support.

remainingCredit.description: The advanced-credit balance remaining after this translation.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the translated image.

downloadUrl.description: The local URL for downloading the translated image.

sizeBytes.description: The translated image size in bytes, up to 50 MB.

file.description: The translated PNG, no larger than 50 MB, uploaded to connector transit storage.

outputSchema.description: The completed ImageTranslate.AI translation and remaining credit balance.
